author: MeThoD
title: Worth every penny I spent.
body:
for the actual bike, it runs great and looks amazing! Much bigger than I had expected, but still fits in my 2025 Santa Fe cargo with some extra space still left. I didn't even have to fold the back seats or anything. Putting the bike together was super easy and I did it alone within 30mins. A little heavy at around 80lbs, but not bad.

Just to put it out there, about a group of 8 men and women stopped me today to ask about this bike and...they all said they would now buy one after I explained it all and showed them the speed and folding mechanics. I feel like I should get some compensation. 😝😜 I felt like a salesman for the bike, even though I was just excited to show them how it works cuz they said they had been looking for a nice ebike.

author: Antonio
title: So glad I switched to an ebike.
body: Bought this ebike for my son we appreciated the quality and how to fold to load into our SUV, assembled very easy weight is not a problem love the headlight.

author: Ghel
title: Awesome E-bike
body: Pros, I love the this ebike, the cons too heavy and the have a little scratch on back and on clamp of handle bar just because of shipping but it is not the big issue. Fast deliver and great delivery guys.

author: SASunshine
title: Nice Bike
body: I recently got my hands on the EK6 bike, and I must say, it's a Nice Bike! It's perfect for cruising around town, and the speed is just right for a leisurely ride. I've been able to cover up to 50 miles without any issues, and it handles well up to 35mph. The design is sleek and modern, and it's definitely turning heads wherever I go. I'd highly recommend this bike to anyone looking for a reliable and stylish ride!

author: Antonio
title: Love
body: Most amazing E-Bike Ever!!!

author: Great e-Bike!
title: Already thinking about buying a second one.
body: Sometimes ordering on line is hard because you are only seeing pictures of what you might be interested in buying. You don't always know how good of a product you are buying. No problem here, I am very happy with this bike. Fit and finish were great and performance was much better than I expected. My 250lbs was no problem for this bike. It is a bit heavy, but I think that's what makes it a quality bike.

author: Nikkel
title: Customer satisfaction with this e-bike.
body: I did a tremendous amount of research on different foldable e-bikes. Always came back looking at this one. Am I glad I did, have had it for a week now and it is above and beyond expectations with the performance and battery. It came delivered and the 90% totally built is not an exaggeration and it all fit perfect. Within 1/2 hour I was going down the road. The only problem I had is the seat was not low enough for me so I texted the company and heard back almost immediately and they will be forwarding me a new design of seat that they say will work better. Looking at getting another for my wife now, I am that impressed. Thank you Emily for the good service

author: Donny Marshall
title: This purchase was worth the money
body: This was a great addition to the family, The bike was exactly like described, and adding it to the game that I love (golf), is a match made in heaven.Customer Service was great, even though the problem was all my like of knowledge, Michelle from customer Service was wonderful, she responded promptly, politely, and very efficiently. You can buy a similar e-bike, buy you can't get another Michelle from Cybervelo Customer Service, for that alone, I would recommend Cybervelo to my family and friends.

author: Karina
title: Worth every penny for my side gig.
body: I deliver packages part-time, and this bike cuts my delivery time in half. The large rear rack holds 3-4 boxes easily, and the 30mph speed gets me between stops fast. Battery lasts my entire 6-hour shift, even with constant start-stopping. Folds up to fit in apartment lobbies when making deliveries there.

author: L. A.
title: My commute's actually enjoyable now, not just a chore to endure.
body: The bike's suspension makes rough trails feel like pavement. I ride through a wooded path to work that's full of tree roots—before this, my hands would go numb from the vibrations. Now? The front fork soaks up all the bumps.

author: Kayla
title: No overnight charging needed.
body: Love that the battery charges from empty to full in under 6 hours. I plug it in when I get home at 7pm, and it’s ready for my 7am commute—no overnight charging needed.

author: Heather Binford
title: Convenient charging system for busy schedules.
body: The charger is compact too, so I can toss it in my work bag if I need to top up during the day.

author: Soymile
title: No more white-knuckling it during autumn rides.
body: This handles wet leaves better than any bike I’ve owned. Fall commutes used to mean skidding through piles of leaves, but the fat tires grip tight. The disc brakes don’t get blocked by wet debris either—still stop instantly when I need them.

author: Soymile
title: No more white-knuckling it during autumn rides.
body: This handles wet leaves better than any bike I’ve owned. Fall commutes used to mean skidding through piles of leaves, but the fat tires grip tight. The disc brakes don’t get blocked by wet debris either—still stop instantly when I need them.

author: Jason Schroeder
title: Battery lasts all day while I stop to take photos.
body: As a photographer, this is perfect for scouting locations. Folds up in my SUV, then I can ride to spots my car can’t reach. The quiet motor lets me get close to wildlife without scaring them off.

author: Kemone Wilson
title: The bike’s weight distribution makes it easy to maneuver.
body: Even with a full basket, it turns smoothly and doesn’t feel unbalanced. I can navigate tight corners in alleyways without worrying about tipping.

author: jia
title: Great for navigating crowded city streets.
body: The responsive steering is precise—no overcorrection needed.

author: Rinka
title: Folds up to store in our garage when we’re done—no more tripping over two bikes.
body: I’ve been using this to teach my daughter to ride a bike, and it’s ideal. The stable ride lets me stay beside her without swerving, and the slow speed setting keeps things safe. When she gets wobbly, I can reach over and steady her without losing my balance.

author: Victo
title: The bike’s resistance when pedaling without assist is minimal.
body: The bike’s resistance when pedaling without assist is minimal. Sometimes I want a workout, so I turn off the motor—and it feels like a regular bike, not like pedaling through mud.

author: tobillos secos
title: Versatile for different moods.
body: The 7 gears let me adjust the difficulty, so I can get exercise when I want it or let the motor do the work when I don’t.

author: Katelyn
title: Great investment!
body: I was worried about the weight, but this e-bike is surprisingly easy to maneuver. The handlebars are responsive, and it stops quickly with the disc brakes. I use it to carry my laptop and gym bag to work, and the rear rack is sturdy enough for heavy loads.

author: Cmmshep
title: Well-thought-out design.
body: This one has rubber gaskets that seal out debris—still folds as smoothly as day one, even after 3 months of dusty rides.

author: Chase
title: Works perfectly.
body: My 14-year-old son loves this e-bike! It’s safe with multiple speed settings, so I can limit how fast he goes. He rides it to school and soccer practice, and the battery lasts through his busy days. It’s durable too—he’s already scraped it a few times, but it still works perfectly.

author: DarthZen13
title: Folds up to fit in the staff locker room
body: I use this to commute to my job at a hospital, where parking is impossible. Folds up to fit in the staff locker room—security doesn’t mind since it’s out of the way.

author: Tay
title: Highly recommend for fitness lovers!
body: I’ve been using this e-bike for my daily workouts, and it’s fantastic. I can choose to pedal normally or use the assist when I’m tired. It’s helped me build up my stamina, and I’ve even lost a few pounds. The seat is adjustable, so it fits me perfectly.

author: Marlo Aryn
title: This e-bike is perfect for commuting in the rain.
body: It has fenders that keep me dry, and the tires have good traction on wet roads. I don’t have to worry about getting stuck in traffic, and I arrive at work on time every day. The battery charges quickly, so I can plug it in at the office and it’s ready to go home.

author: Roger
title: Security doesn’t mind since it’s out of the way.
body: I use this to commute to my job at a hospital, where parking is impossible. Folds up to fit in the staff locker room—security doesn’t mind since it’s out of the way.

author: TP
title: I couldn’t ask for a better way to stay active!
body: I bought this e-bike for my retirement, and it’s been wonderful. I ride it to the farmers’ market, take scenic routes by the lake, and meet friends for coffee. It’s easy to get on and off, with a low step-through frame, and the ride is smooth.

author: Fernanda Hernández
title: Battery lasts my entire 8-hour shift, even with constant stops.
body: The speed gets me through traffic faster than cars during rush hour. The insulated bag attachment fits perfectly on the rear rack, keeping food hot.

author: Ximena G Buntin
title: The storage basket is handy for carrying snacks and toys.
body: This e-bike is great for families. My husband and I take turns riding it, and we even attach a child seat for our toddler. It’s stable enough for two people, and the battery has enough power to last through our weekend outings.

author: Maving
title: Low maintenance is a major advantage
body: The tires of this car require almost no maintenance. I used it for four months and never inflated it once - the wide tires have an amazing pressure-holding capacity. There's no need to carry repair tools everywhere anymore.

author: Jerry Donald
title: No issues at all—definitely recommend!
body: I was impressed by how easy this e-bike is to assemble. The instructions were clear, and all the parts were labeled. It took me less than 30 minutes to put it together, and I’m not very handy. Once assembled, it worked perfectly right away.

author: Jose Farías
title: Very cool!
body: This e-bike has a sleek, minimalist design that I love. It doesn’t look bulky like some other e-bikes, and the black color matches everything. I use it to run errands around town, and it’s so convenient. The battery is hidden in the frame, which makes it look more like a regular bike.

author: k42uk1
title: Nice Bike
body: The rear rack can hold my small shovel, gloves and harvest basket without shaking.

author: Shirly ortiz
title: It’s a reliable bike that I can count on for years to come.
body: I’ve had this e-bike for 6 months, and it’s still going strong. The battery life hasn’t decreased at all, and all the components are still in good condition. I ride it on rough trails sometimes, and it handles them well.

author: Tawnya
title: Best purchase for school!
body: This e-bike is perfect for college students. I use it to get around campus, and it’s much faster than walking. The folding feature means I can store it in my dorm room without taking up too much space. It’s also affordable, which is important for a student budget.

author: Vernon
title: The included kickstand is sturdy.
body: Anybody out there can help me get me a new back rim for my ek6 ebike

author: Kar
title: E bike
body: The bike’s control panel is easy to use even with gloves on.

author: Luvenia Exson
title: Highly recommend!
body: I love how versatile this e-bike is. I can use it for commuting, exercise, or just fun rides. The different assist levels let me customize my ride—sometimes I want a workout, and sometimes I just want to coast. It’s also easy to clean, which is a plus.

author: Heather L
title: Wide tires keep us stable.
body: I’ve been using this to commute with my toddler in a child seat, and it’s rock solid. The sturdy frame doesn’t flex with the extra weight, and the wide tires keep us stable.

author: bob
title: It’s a great way to get outside and enjoy nature.
body: This e-bike has made me more active. Before, I would stay home on weekends, but now I’m out exploring new trails and parks. The ride is comfortable, even on long trips, and the battery gives me the confidence to go further.

author: Masumi
title: So easy to learn
body: I was nervous about riding an e-bike, but this one is so easy to learn. The controls are simple, and it feels stable right from the start. I’ve only had it a month, but I’m already hooked. It’s made getting around so much more enjoyable. I wish I had bought it sooner!

author: DL
title: Nice to have a bike that stays looking new.
body: The bike’s paint has held up beautifully against scratches. I’ve leaned it against brick walls, metal bike racks, and concrete posts—no chips or scrapes. The matte black finish hides minor scuffs too, so it still looks good even with regular use.

author: Noe Remache
title: Folds up to store in the shelter’s utility closet during my shift.
body: The quiet motor doesn’t wake up the neighbors when I leave at 5am. The basket holds my volunteer vest, treats for the dogs, and cleaning supplies without issue.

author: E_Marie
title: The quick-release lever makes changes in seconds, no tools needed.
body: The bike’s seat adjusts to accommodate different riding styles. For commuting, I raise it for better efficiency; for casual rides, I lower it for comfort.

author: Raj Siva
title: Enough for comfort.
body: The seat itself has just the right amount of padding—firm enough for support, soft enough for comfort.

author: Enrico
title: Folds up to fit in my truck bed when we’re done.
body: The responsive brakes let me stop quickly if kids dart in front, and the sturdy frame takes the occasional bump against ramps.

author: just some guy
title: EK6 Max great bike.
body: The EK6 Max is large.  I am 5'8" and underestimated how large it is, especially since I have not ridden a bike in a long time and this is my first e-bike.  The EK6M has exceeded my expectations so far and the battery came fully charged.  The speed is zippy based on my initial ride and I am still getting dialed in to layout.  My experience was mainly with mtb's at less than 15lbs so the the 79lbs still requires some adjustments.  The hydraulic brakes worked much better than the old double shoe style so decelerating quickly added to a safer feel.  The assembly time was around 1 hour-ish and not too bad.  included instructions were good and many videos on how to assemble are on the product page.  I am not sure how many makers include rim tape on their wheels, but the EK6M has the tape installed.  The aesthetics are good and that what drew my attention.Highly recommend the bike.. just remember their size recommendation is important.

author: Leland Cannon
title: The battery charger of this car is small and lightweight.
body: When I travel, I can throw it into my backpack, so I never have to worry about running out of power during long trips. It can also be used on 110v and 220v sockets, which was very convenient when I took it to Canada. The accessory design is very considerate.

author: Pamela Cheatwood
title: Game-changer
body: I’ve been using this to ride to my evening college classes, and it’s a game-changer. Parking on campus is impossible, but this folds up to fit in the classroom closet.

author: Francis X. Serio
title: Fun
body: It’s wonderful

author: Bernadette Frank
title: Good bike
body: The battery lasts through my 2-hour commute and evening classes—no need to find an outlet. The LED lights help me navigate the dark campus paths after class too.

author: Mnrockstar1980
title: Before ride and after first ride
body: I’m posting this review before first ride still on the charger, but great bike just went on the first ride. It exceeded my expectations. What a great bike. I would highly recommend buying this bike.

author: sandra
title: Customer service even checked in to see how I liked it.
body: After 6 months of daily use, this e-bike is still performing like new. The battery hasn’t lost any capacity, the gears still shift smoothly, and the brakes are as responsive as day one. I’ve ridden it in rain, snow, and sunshine—no rust or wear issues.

author: David voutas
title: Durable
body: Received it in a timely manner and love it so far

author: Sara eastman
title: Nice
body: Nice

author: Aaron Downey
title: I love my new e bike
body: I can't believe how easy it was to assembleI love the comfortable yet sporty bike..It's pretty fast and has great torque..I'd def recommend this bike..Awesome in all terrain

author: LJG
title: Nice Bike
body: My buddies are serious cyclists, and I always struggled to keep pace, especially on hills. This e-MTB has leveled the playing field. I can now join their group rides without holding anyone back. I still pedal hard, but the assist bridges the fitness gap. It's been fantastic for our social rides - we can chat, explore together, and I don't arrive totally wiped out. They tease me about the 'cheater bike,' but honestly, it's kept me riding with friends I would have had to stop joining otherwise.

author: Vanessa
title: Opens up a lot more terrain without needing a truck.
body: We have miles of old logging roads and forest service roads near us. My regular bike was fine on the smooth parts, but any washboard or loose gravel was rough. This e-bike handles it much better. The wider tires and suspension absorb the chatter, and the motor helps maintain momentum over the bumpy sections. It's not for technical singletrack, but for exploring those backcountry fire roads and accessing fishing spots? Absolutely ideal.

author: Jenny A.
title: help me with my daily commute
body: I used to dread my 8-mile commute to work, especially the big hill at the end. This e-MTB has completely changed that. The pedal assist is so smooth; it feels like I have super legs! I can tackle that hill without breaking a sweat or showing up to work drenched. I mostly stick to paved paths and bike lanes, but it handles the occasional gravel shortcut or curb hop with ease. The range is perfect for my round trip, even with some assist. Honestly, it's made riding to work something I look forward to now, not a chore. Totally worth it for the time saved and the fun factor.

author: Pablo HF
title: I get to see more nature without feeling completely spent afterwards.
body: Love hitting the local greenway trails on weekends, but some sections used to wear me out. With this e-bike, I can explore further and enjoy the ride more. The different assist levels are great - I crank it up on the climbs so I can save energy, then dial it back or turn it off on the flats and downhills to still get exercise. The suspension makes roots and small bumps way more comfortable than my old hardtail. It's not a motocross bike, but for maintained dirt and gravel trails? Perfect.

author: Amy meyers
title: Just remember to bring a good lock!
body: Tired of driving short distances just for groceries? This bike with the rear rack and panniers has been amazing. I can easily carry a week's worth of groceries for one person. The motor helps immensely, especially when loaded up or going uphill with bags. It feels stable and secure. I've even used it for trips to the hardware store. It's way more fun than sitting in traffic, gets me some fresh air, and saves on gas.

author: Giselle M.
title: It's brought back the joy of cycling in my own neighborhood that I thought I'd lost.
body: I live in a hilly area. Beautiful views, but cycling was always punishing. This e-bike is like a cheat code! I can actually enjoy rides with significant elevation gain now. Instead of dreading every climb, I look forward to the challenge knowing the assist is there. I still get a great workout because I'm pedaling, but it's sustainable and enjoyable, not soul-crushing.

author: Cabiness
title: Perfect for Evening Rides After Work
body: After a long day at the desk, the last thing I wanted was an exhausting bike ride. Now, I hop on my e-MTB for a relaxing evening spin. I can explore neighborhoods, ride along the river path, or just cruise without feeling pressured to push hard. The lights are bright enough for dusk rides, and the upright position is comfortable. It's become my favorite way to de-stress and get some gentle exercise without overdoing it. Highly recommend for unwinding.

author: Foldable
title: Responsive brakes inspire confidence.
body: Great dual suspension

author: Erin Brooks
title: No unexpected repairs or part replacements.
body: After 10 months of ownership, this bike has required minimal maintenance. I’ve lubricated the chain a few times, adjusted the brakes once, and that’s it.

author: Shelly
title: Solid Build & Surprisingly Low Maintenance
body: I've put about 50 miles on mine, mostly pavement and light trails. It's been rock-solid reliable. The components feel durable and well-chosen for the price point. I was worried an e-bike would be high maintenance, but so far, it's been as easy as my old analog bike – just regular chain cleaning/lubing and tire pressure checks. The battery holds its charge well between rides. It feels like a quality machine built to last for regular use.

author: Heather Binford
title: Don't underestimate the fun factor!
body: Honestly, I bought it mostly for practicality – commuting and errands. What surprised me is how much FUN it is! There's a thrill in the smooth acceleration when you pedal, conquering hills effortlessly, and just the feeling of cruising with a little extra help. It puts a smile on my face every time I ride. It's made everyday journeys enjoyable and rekindled my love for just being on a bike.

author: Tonio
title: Adaptable to whatever the city throws at me.
body: The motor kicks in without hesitation. Folded it up to carry through a pedestrian tunnel when the road was blocked—would’ve been stuck without it.

author: Jessica A. Schaap
title: Finally, an e-bike that fits my needs.
body: As a senior rider, I appreciate how easy this is to mount and dismount. The step-through design means I don’t have to swing my leg high, which is tough on my knees. The low center of gravity keeps it stable when I get on/off. Pedal assist level 1 gives just enough help without making me feel out of control.

author: Arpita Chakraborty
title: Nice Bike
body: Used this for a weekend camping trip, and it was ideal. Rode 12 miles to a remote lake—no cars allowed, so this was the perfect transport. The battery lasted the round trip, even with the hilly terrain.

author: Great EBike
title: I've put over 100 miles on it, still perfect.
body: Sturdy. Rides nice.. I weigh, 350lbs?, goes 25 MPH with no issue. With assistance, from me I can get it to 35mph and I'm disabled... So. The charge hasn't even depleted enough for me to lose a bar, yet.

author: Shannon & Ricky
title: Kept dust out of the gears with the included cover too.
body: Folded up small enough to tuck under our tent vestibule at night.

author: Excelente producto
title: Nice
body:
La batería es buena, la carga dura una semana (claro, que esto depende del uso que le den)
El asiento es cómodo y suave, aunque a simple vista se vea un poco extraño .
Es un poco pesada, y esto aveces dificulta hacer acrobacias, pero aparte de eso, no tengo ninguna queja hasta el momento…
Excelente elección, sin duda alguna ha sido una buena inversión !!! lose a bar, yet.

author: Rinka
title: Fits us both.
body: The bike’s handlebars adjust to different heights, which is great for my family. I (5’8”) and my spouse (5’2”) can both get comfortable without tools—just loosen the clamp and move them. The grips are ergonomic too, fitting both our hand sizes. No more arguing over who gets to ride because it fits us both.

author: Jake Snow
title: Worth every penny!
body: I was skeptical about buying an e-bike online, but this one blew me away! I use it to commute 10 miles to work daily, and the battery lasts all week with moderate use. The pedal assist is smooth, and I love that I can adjust the speed easily. It’s lightweight enough for me to carry up the stairs to my apartment.

author: Katz
title: Feel smooth.
body: The battery lasts longer than I expected—after 5 days of 15-mile round trips, it still had juice left. Folding it up fits perfectly in my garage, and the fat tires make bumpy roads feel smooth.

author: Connie T
title: Great for both city rides and trail adventures.
body: last weekend I rode 80 miles on assist mode and still had 20% left. The hydraulic brakes are responsive, which is crucial when going fast. Assembly was a breeze since it’s 90% done—took me 40 minutes tops.

author: Pink Carter
title: Love it
body: Living in a snowy area, I needed a bike that could handle winter. These 4.0 fat tires are amazing—gripped the snow and ice like a champ.

author: Melissa lynn
title: Definitely recommend for anyone in harsh weather.
body: The 8-speed shifter works smoothly, and the motor doesn’t make much noise.

author: Kayla
title: No overnight charging needed.
body: Love that the battery charges from empty to full in under 6 hours. I plug it in when I get home at 7pm, and it’s ready for my 7am commute—no overnight charging needed.

author: Heather Binford
title: Convenient charging system for busy schedules.
body: The charger is compact too, so I can toss it in my work bag if I need to top up during the day.

body: This handles wet leaves better than any bike I’ve owned. Fall commutes used to mean skidding through piles of leaves, but the fat tires grip tight. The disc brakes don’t get blocked by wet debris either—still stop instantly when I need them.

title: Versatile for different moods.
body: The 7 gears let me adjust the difficulty, so I can get exercise when I want it or let the motor do the work when I don’t.

author: Mac Coley
title: Solid build quality, feels durable.
body: The removable battery is a lifesaver—I just take it inside to charge overnight, no need to haul the whole bike. The LCD display is easy to read, showing speed and battery life clearly.

author: Divya Bansal
title: Battery charges in about 6 hours, which is reasonable.
body: The magnesium frame is light but sturdy—carrying it up my porch steps isn’t a hassle. The dual suspension makes bumpy trails feel like smooth pavement. Rode it through gravel and mud last weekend, and the fat tires didn’t slip once.

author: María José
title: Happy with the purchase.
body: As someone who hates complicated setups, I was relieved how easy this was to put together. The instructions were clear, and all parts were there. The throttle mode is great when I’m tired—just cruise without pedaling. The 100-mile range is a stretch, but I get 70-80 on a full charge, which is more than enough for my weekend trips.

author: JCM
title: Took it camping last month, and it handled dirt roads like a pro.
body: The foldable feature is perfect for my SUV—fits in the back with room to spare for groceries.

author: QTD
title: The seat is comfortable for long rides, which is a plus.
body: The 20-inch wheels are a good size, not too big or small. Hydraulic brakes stop on a dime, even when going downhill.

author: Eyerusalem
title: This e-bike has changed my weekends!
body: I take it to the park, run errands, and even go on small adventures. The fat tires make it stable on gravel roads, and the brakes are responsive. Assembly took less than an hour with the clear instructions. My kids beg to ride on the back seat—total family favorite!

author: Quieoy
title: The design is sleek too—got so many compliments!
body: As someone who hates sweating during commutes, this e-bike is a game-changer. I arrive at work fresh, even on hot days. The battery charges quickly, and the LED lights are bright for early morning rides.

author: k42uk1
title: Highly recommend for city dwellers!
body: I’ve had this e-bike for 2 months now, and it’s holding up great. The suspension makes bumpy roads feel smooth, and I can easily tackle hills that used to leave me breathless. The battery indicator is accurate, so I never get stranded.

author: Very Cool, Good Quality
title: Great little bike for the price.
body: Loving this bike very good quality, started have a little trouble with rear motor, contacted customer service and they were very helpful and sent out a new motor with in a few days. Have to give customer service a A+ on help and service 100%. Thanks

author: Powerful E-bike
title: The grips are comfortable and non-slip.
body: Love the look of the bike. It has power and is super comfortable! Had to replace the headlight due to damage during shipping, and customer service was fast and responsive sending me a new one. Very happy with the purchase.
